defuss-shadcn / Website / Resume & Portfolio / portfolio-playful

Playful Portfolio

A portfolio with a grin - a pastel hero with wobbling blobs, a flower-shaped portrait wearing a spinning sticker, a headline that rotates what the illustrator draws, polaroids on a table that filter by kind and open in a viewer, how a drawing happens, commissions with prices, kind words in speech bubbles, a shelf of shape stickers, a contact dialog and the story of every drawing on a page of its own. One of the Resume & Portfolio styles.

Open full screen

Juno Park, illustrator

A cream, cobalt and candy palette and Bricolage Grotesque on the page's root; a Site Header with a flower for a logo and the hello button; corner-blob blobs that wobble behind the hero; Text Rotate; a shape-flower portrait with a shape-burst sticker; News Ticker (pill); Portfolio Grid (scatter) with frame-tape - radios filter it by kind (:has()), each piece is a button that opens the Media Gallery's viewer (commandfor + command="show-modal") on its drawing, whose 'Read the story' opens the drawing's page (#/work/walrus-wally: the brief, what was drawn, how it went, the client's words, more pictures, previous and next); four process cards, three offers whose buttons open the contact dialog with their kind chosen, two speech-bubble quotes; a shelf of shape-heart, shape-cloud, shape-star-6 and shape-daisy stickers; Skill Matrix (tags); Availability (spotlight) on pattern-polka; a Site Footer on a pink card. Motion pops everything in.

×%

Built from Site Header, Text Rotate, News Ticker (pill), Portfolio Grid (scatter), Skill Matrix (tags), Availability (spotlight), Avatar and a contact Dialog with Input, Select and Textarea, and Site Footer. The pieces open in the Media Gallery's viewer; the filter is radios read by :has(). Every drawing has a story page - a route of defuss-dom-router filled from a data block: #/work/walrus-wally shows the brief, what was drawn, how it went, the client's words and more pictures, with Article Navigation to the previous and the next; the viewer's "Read the story", the ticker's clients and the footer lead there, the header's sections are anchors of the home view. The palette, the round corners and the typeface are set on the page's root. The flower, the blobs, the burst, the tape, the stickers and the patterns are Shapes utilities, the entrances Motion's.
